name: Westfield MainPlace
description: Westfield MainPlace is a prominent enclosed regional shopping center in the heart of Orange County, offering a diverse mix of national retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues. As one of Santa Ana's premier shopping destinations, the mall serves the surrounding communities with convenient access and a comprehensive retail experience. The center combines traditional mall anchors with contemporary retail brands to cater to a broad demographic.
demographics: Westfield MainPlace serves a diverse Orange County demographic with a strong representation of middle to upper-middle-class families, primarily spanning ages 25-54 with household incomes ranging from $60,000-$120,000. The trade area draws heavily from Santa Ana, Orange, and Tustin communities, featuring a multicultural visitor base with significant Hispanic and Asian populations. Typical shoppers include young families seeking value-oriented fashion and dining options, as well as teen and young adult consumers drawn to contemporary retailers and entertainment offerings.
summary: Westfield MainPlace is a major enclosed regional mall in Santa Ana offering diverse shopping, dining, and entertainment for Orange County families and communities.
